type Identity<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] };
const uppercase: Readonly<Uppercase<string>> = 'ABC';
const plain: string = uppercase;
const template: Identity<`id-${string}`> = 'id-one';
const exact: `id-${string}` = template;
const optional: Partial<`ref-${number}`> = 'ref-4';
const capitalized: Capitalize<Lowercase<string>> = 'Hello';
const recased: Uppercase<Lowercase<string>> = 'ABC';
const uncapitalized: Uncapitalize<Uppercase<string>> = 'aBC';
const inside: `id-${Capitalize<Lowercase<string>>}` = 'id-World';
console.log(plain, exact, optional, capitalized, recased, uncapitalized, inside);

function stringify<T>(value: { toString(): T }): T {
  return value.toString();
}
const fromUppercase: string = stringify(uppercase);
const fromTemplate: string = stringify(template);
console.log(fromUppercase.toLowerCase(), fromTemplate.toUpperCase(), stringify('Plain').toLowerCase());
